decision: Use an opt-in family screening pack in the existing shared SCREEN engine and channel adapters.

scope.legacyProfile: No family flag preserves the existing DRG flow.
scope.geneProfile: Explicit family-only profile enables family intake and refers unrelated matters.
scope.mixedProfile: Family plus other supported areas retains those existing matter paths.

classification: AI identifies family area independently from whether the selected firm accepts it; exact user text is retained as evidence.
lifecycle: Use existing follow-up, channel question budgets, insight, contact and completion steps.
report: Family report is factual and intake-only. Legacy numeric fields are internal compatibility sentinels and are omitted from family display, copy and CRM preview. No calibrated suitability or fee claims.
transport: Sandbox completion is local and does not write leads or contact a firm. Only extraction and pending-answer mapping call the preview AI endpoint.
compatibility: Existing APIs gain optional profile metadata; no database migrations or production setting changes.
rollback: Preserve codex/rollback-screen-family-20261109-* refs. New implementation is isolated on codex/screen-family-multichannel-20261109 and reviewed as draft PRs. Rehearse reverse patch and baseline smoke tests before release.
productionRelease: Held for explicit approval of the specific PRs after preview review.
